modelspec.artifact.ContentHash.title: ContentHash
modelspec.artifact.ContentHash.description: A blake3 digest under explicit serialization and version rules (DESIGN.md § 7).

modelspec.data.PackedSplit.title: PackedSplit
modelspec.data.PackedSplit.description: One split of a PackedDataset, the file `train.tokens` for Train and `heldout.tokens` for HeldOut, little-endian `i32` token ids with no header, sequence_count × seq_len values (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

sequence_count.description: The number of sequences of seq_len tokens the split's token stream holds, its partial tail dropped. A split whose stream is shorter than one sequence is refused (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

content_hash.description: The blake3 hash of the split's packed file, 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

modelspec.data.SplitRole.title: SplitRole
modelspec.data.SplitRole.description: What a split is used for; MLM loss and accuracy are evaluated on the held-out split (epic:bert-from-scratch).
